name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, meaning all engagement is coming entirely from Google Business Profile, which generated 110 total actions including 3 calls, 73 direction requests, and 34 website clicks. The biggest concern is a 71.43% drop in GBP engagement over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a listing visibility issue that should be investigated promptly.

performance.verdict: GBP is the only live signal; 3-day trend is now zero.

findings.text: GBP is the sole revenue-facing channel; paid spend has been $0 for all 28 days observed. No CPL can be computed.
GBP 3-day signal (Aug 17–19) is 0+0+0 actions vs prior 3-day (Aug 14–16) of 2+3+2=7 — confirmed collapse, not noise.
OVERDUE SOW: 3 CRM milestones unresolved — 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list priority (Jul 28), dedup workbook + 126 accounts (Jul 31) — all past due by 3–6 weeks.
GBP 7d vs prior 7d dropped -71.43%; the 45-day series shows high volatility (0–12 actions/day) with no paid support, making the listing fully dependent on organic search demand.
GA4, Search Console, Instagram, and GHL all read zero for 28 days — either tracking is broken or these channels are genuinely inactive. Data gap, not a confirmed result.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — check for suspension, ownership conflict, or category change causing the 3-day zero.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for Aug 17–18–19, down from 7 actions in the prior 3 days and a 28-day total of 110 actions — this is the only active lead channel. Check the listing for suspension status, ownership flags, or any recent category/description edits. Success = actions resume above the 45-day daily average of ~4 within 3 days of any fix confirmed. Re-check by 2026-08-23.
